```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!-- Parameter entity comment -->">
  <!ENTITY ent "General Entity Text">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  %pe;
]>
<?processing-instruction target="value" data="test"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Main root comment -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section containing <tags> and &ent; reference inside ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % gen-macro "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; Extended">
  %gen-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- First comment block -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Some literal data with a comment <!-- inside cdata -->
    ]]>
  </item>
  <note>Note section referencing &derived;</note>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Value">
  <!ENTITY beta "α -> Beta Value">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
  <?custom-pi target="attr" value="data"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://xml.org/database" xmlns:db="http://xml.org/db">
  <!-- Database documentation comment -->
  <db:record id="rec1">
    <![CDATA[
      <record>Nested-looking CDATA text with β</record>
    ]]>
  </db:record>
  <record>β</record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref1 "Reference One">
  <!ENTITY ref2 "&ref1; and Two">
  <!ENTITY % entity_macro "<!ENTITY macro_ent 'Expanded Macro'>">
  %entity_macro;
  <?archive-meta version="1.0"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.org/archive" xmlns:m="http://xml.org/archive/meta">
  <!-- Archive top-level comment -->
  <m:file id="f1">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw bytes & macro_ent &ref2;
    ]]>
  </m:file>
  <file>&macro_ent;</file>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY content_ent "Entity String Content">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY external_doc "doc.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % internal_subset "
    <!ELEMENT internal (#PCDATA)>
  ">
  %internal_subset;
  <?xml-log level="debug"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:sec="http://xml.org/doc/sec">
  <!-- Document level descriptive comment -->
  <sec:section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with <xml> markup and &content_ent;
    ]]>
  </sec:section>
  <section>&content_ent;</section>
</document>
```
